name: CAMP TALES
source:
Join Telmo the turtle, Celia the zebra, and Jude the wild boar on an excursion where you have camped at nightfall.

Once you're settled in, tell them the story of where you're going to spend the night. You're the one who knows the story, so you can tell it however you like, choosing various narrative suggestions that will affect the mood of the three friends.

You have to try to make sure that no one collapses from terror after hearing your story!

Discover their likes and dislikes through immersive, diverse conversations, and try to avoid choices that accumulate stress on a single character.

Good luck finding the good ending ;)

[Translated from [url=https://othascarlet.itch.io/camp-tales]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与乌龟特尔莫、斑马西莉亚和野猪裘德一起在夜幕降临时露营。

安顿下来后，告诉他们你将在哪里过夜。你是了解这个故事的人，所以你可以随心所欲地讲述它，选择各种会影响三个朋友心情的叙事建议。

你必须尽力确保没有人在听完你的故事后因恐惧而崩溃！

通过身临其境、多样化的对话来发现他们的好恶，并尽量避免给单一角色带来压力的选择。

祝你好运找到好结局;)

[译自[url=https://othascarlet.itch.io/camp-tales]Itch.io[/url]]
